final: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.n) AS avg_rentals_above, AVG(r.n - a.m) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM r, a WHERE r.n > a.m
